headline: The queue chooses you
fortune: This week, the slowest line will suddenly move the moment you join it. Try not to look too powerful.

headline: Your chai stays hot
fortune: One busy morning, you will finish your chai while it is still hot. Even Mithu considers this a promotion.

headline: The good seat waits
fortune: Before Friday, the best seat in the room will be empty just for you—shade, breeze, and no wobbly leg.

headline: Your ride waits for you
fortune: You will reach the stop just as your ride arrives—no sprinting, no heroic waving, dignity fully intact.

headline: The rain learns manners
fortune: The rain will begin after you get indoors and stop before you leave. The clouds finally respect you.

headline: Your pocket saves the day
fortune: Exactly when you need change, your pocket will produce the right coin. Please thank Past You.

headline: Your song walks in
fortune: A favorite song will begin in an ordinary shop, and for three minutes the vegetable aisle becomes your film set.

headline: The mango keeps its promise
fortune: The fruit you choose will be perfectly sweet, not secretly made of disappointment. A small but serious victory.

headline: Every light turns kind
fortune: On a day you are running late, the road will give you three green lights in a row. Do not abuse this royal treatment.

headline: Your hair agrees
fortune: On a day with no special plans, your hair will look excellent. Naturally, everyone important will appear.

headline: The stubborn jar surrenders
fortune: A difficult lid will open on your first try in front of witnesses. Accept the applause with humility.

headline: The knot gives up
fortune: A tangled necklace or shoelace will come loose without a fight. Even tiny problems are taking the day off.

headline: The price shrinks politely
fortune: Something you already wanted will cost a little less than expected. Spend the victory responsibly—perhaps on jalebi.
